oneLiner: Paste your rough status bullets and get two polished updates instantly: one for execs, one for your team.
problem: People who write frequent status updates waste time reformatting the same information for different audiences, often stripping out detail for leadership or adding too much jargon for peers, leading to inconsistent, unclear communication.
targetUser: Project managers, team leads, and individual contributors who send recurring status updates to both leadership and their immediate team
coreFlow: User pastes or types rough status bullets into a single input box
User selects context (e.g. project name, audience emphasis, urgency)
Tool generates two versions: a concise exec summary and a detailed team update
User reviews and edits either version inline
User copies or exports the final versions to email, Slack, or docs

screens.name: Input Screen
screens.purpose: Capture raw bullet points and optional context like project name or tone preference

screens.name: Dual Output Screen
screens.purpose: Display exec and team versions side by side for comparison and editing

screens.name: Edit & Refine Screen
screens.purpose: Allow inline tweaks, regeneration of a single version, or tone adjustments

screens.name: Export/Share Screen
screens.purpose: Copy to clipboard, download, or send directly to email/Slack integrations

screens.name: History Screen
screens.purpose: View and reuse past updates for recurring status reports

outOfScope: Real-time collaborative editing with multiple users
Direct integration with project management tools (e.g. Jira, Asana) for auto-pulling status data
Automated scheduling or sending of updates on a recurring basis
Support for languages other than English at launch
